answers.core: It cannot be done with an asset library i don't think. These type of features usually get cast to the wayside in my experience as "not necessary for most games" but i was kind of baffled to find out you can't make the window's visible = false.
answers.workaround: There is no way i could find to work around it. The closest I got was to set the window borderless and 0 in height, but the program still appears on the hotbar. I also considered using headless godot but the problem then becomes you cannot make the window visible if a crash does happen, as there is no window.
